answer.report_md: 本页需生成一幅五面板复合图：上方四个年份饼图采用不同排线纹理、外置百分比及引线；下方为双纵轴、双线型折线图，并含双向增长率箭头、双向虚线网格和脚注。饼图数值需用“年份＋部门代码”寻址；折线值还需“年份＋系列”。最难的是精度：左轴间隔100、右轴间隔4，200与12.5均未标在数据点上。末项12.5也可能与1979年MI的12.5%混淆，我按顺序判为2015年人均GDP。

components.evidence: The lower panel has left “Overall GDP” and right “Per capita GDP” value axes.
Four repeated pie charts appear for 1969, 1979, 2000 and 2015.
Four pie panels sit above a separate dual-axis line panel.
The pie panels are individually headed “1969”, “1979”, “2000” and “2015”.
Axes read “Overall GDP (10⁹ DA 1979)” and “Per capita GDP (10³ DA 1979)”.
Both GDP axis titles run vertically beside the lower plot.
“Overall GDP (1)” points to “(1) Average annual growth rate of overall GDP compared to 1979”.
Labels such as “EI 30.7%” and “S 41.2%” sit outside pies on leader lines.
The lines are directly named “Overall GDP (1)” and “GDP per capita” inside the plot.
“GDP per capita” uses a dash-dot line while “Overall GDP” is solid.
